audits.source_name: Belfast City Council Democratic Services minutes
audits.license: UK Open Government Licence (OGL) where applicable to public-sector information; verify page-specific copyright and third-party attachments before production import.
audits.coverage_years_checked: Selected Belfast committee minute/report pages from 2013 through 2025; candidate dates retained only inside 2008-01-01 to 2026-05-19.
audits.update_frequency: Meeting-by-meeting publication; historical pages can be amended or republished by Democratic Services.
audits.geographic_scope: Belfast City Council projects, public realm, facilities and programme decisions.
audits.granularity: Committee item/report paragraph; many records are programme-level rather than row-level GIS features.
audits.key_fields_used: Meeting date, item title, official minute/report text, named project/site, source URL and committee item ID.
audits.required_caveats: Council minutes are strong evidence that a decision/status/opening was reported to committee, but they are not authoritative surveyed geometry and may report prior work without exact per-site completion dates.
audits.ingestion_recommendation: Recommended for a small official public-record tail when candidates are clearly labelled as minute-reported milestones and not used for physical completion/outcome claims beyond the source wording.
audits.next_checks: For production import, resolve official project pages or capital-programme attachments where available, and replace approximate points with authoritative site geometries.

audits.license: UK Open Government Licence (OGL) where applicable to public-sector information; verify page-specific copyright and third-party media before production import.
audits.coverage_years_checked: Selected Belfast City Council news records through 2026-05-19.
audits.geographic_scope: Belfast council public facilities, active travel and civic projects.
audits.key_fields_used: News date, title, named project/network, source URL.
audits.reliability: strong for official announcement dates; usable with caveats for network-level geometry
audits.required_caveats: News releases can document launch/announcement milestones but should not be used to infer usage outcomes, causality or long-term condition.
audits.ingestion_recommendation: Use as source evidence for small factual public-facility/network milestones; retain source URL and avoid reproducing media.

audits.license: Open Government Licence v3.0 where applicable to public-sector statistical releases.
audits.coverage_years_checked: Previously mined Belfast planning-statistics rounds 131, 134, 137, 145, 151, 165 and 171 were treated as near-exhausted.
audits.reliability: strong for administrative planning decisions, but exhausted for this worker
audits.required_caveats: Planning records remain administrative records and are not evidence of construction, occupation, opening or final built form.
audits.ingestion_recommendation: Not mined in round177 to avoid low-value duplicates.
